Depending upon the duration of MTV utilization, FAU costs may be billed to the MTV user monthly, quarterly, or on a different collectively agreed-upon schedule. To assist in alleviating costs for MTV users, SNMREC will work alongside other federal, state, local, and private programs to provide financial assistance. For example, use of the MTV may qualify as an “open water” project under the Technical Expertise for Marine Energy (TEAMER)9 program.
